validity.researcher_notes: P2040/Phase II is a genuine, currently-tracked segment of Mountaineer Gas Company's (a West Virginia LDC, WV-PSC-regulated, NOT FERC-jurisdictional) multi-phase 'Eastern Panhandle' distribution-line buildout under its PSC-approved Infrastructure Replacement and Expansion Plan (IREP, approved 2016-11-18). Four independent-origin sources corroborate: (1) Mountaineer Gas Co's own 2016-11-18 press release (PSC approves IREP; 'Segments two and three are planned for future expansion in Jefferson County'); (2) Pipeline & Gas Journal's Oct-2018 'Planned Projects' trade-press listing, which explicitly lists 'Project: Mountaineer Gas Pipeline Phase II / Segment: Charlestown Loop / Length: 24.5 miles / Status: Project is awaiting WV PSC approval' under a 'MOUNTAINEER GAS CO.' operator header; (3) dcmediagroup.us (Oct 25, 2018), reporting a WV PSC public hearing on 'the proposed extension of the Mountaineer Gas Pipeline [that] would cut through Jefferson County to supply a new industrial park near Charles Town' (the Rockwool plant); (4) heraldmailmedia.com (Jan 3, 2019), describing 'a second segment of the expansion project [that] includes extending natural-gas service from near the Berkeley-Jefferson County line ... to the Rockwool ... plant ... in Ranson, W.Va.' Ranson and Charles Town are adjacent twin towns in Jefferson County, WV, consistent with the PGJ segment name 'Charlestown Loop.' This confirms the segment both EXISTS and is correctly attributed to Mountaineer Gas Co's own LDC buildout, not to any FERC project. Per explicit task guidance, this is NOT the same pipeline as P0221 'Mountaineer XPress Gas Pipeline' (TC Energy/Columbia Gas Transmission, FERC docket CP16-357, confirmed via EIA's own Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbooks as a wholly separate interstate project feeding the 'TCO pool') — a name collision only, correctly not merged. It is also distinct from TC Energy/Columbia Gas Transmission's separate interstate 'Eastern Panhandle Expansion Project' (FERC docket CP17-80; EIA workbooks show this project 'On Hold' 2019-2021 after 'Maryland rejected easement for project in January 2019', intended to 'Deliver to Mountaineer Gas in Morgan County, WV' as a wholesale supply lateral) -- that TC Energy project is not present as any PID in this 46-row roster and is noted here only as corroborating context for the classification call, not as a cross_row_lead. CAVEAT: the worklist's 'irregular' flag on the Location cluster (StartLocation=EndLocation=Charlestown, WV) is CORRECT, not a defect -- 'Charlestown Loop' is a loop-configuration distribution segment that begins and ends at/near the same reference point in Jefferson County; see the Location fill for full sourcing. SEPARATE DISCOVERY NOTE (not a cross_row_lead -- no matching PID in this roster): the same PGJ Oct-2018 document also lists a 'Mountaineer Gas Pipeline Phase III' (Length 4.4 miles, Status 'awaiting WV PSC approval' as of Oct 2018, matching Herald-Mail's 'a third segment project ... considered for the Shepherdstown area') that does not correspond to any ProjectID in the given 46-row roster -- flagging this as a possible GEM tracking gap for Baird's attention; no fabricated cross_row_leads entry created since the schema requires a roster PID.
